description: THIS SPECIAL NOTICE IS FOR INFORMATIONAL PURPOSES ONLY.  This notice is issued for the purpose of informing industry of the Government's forecasted opportunities. It does not constitute a solicitation and shall not be construed as a commitment by the Government. Please see the attached “Adelphi Contracting Division Fair Opportunity FY26 Quarter 2” document for more information.  All questions and concerns shall be addressed to the POC identified for the specific opportunity.
